significance.justification: A verified-true result would establish the form-(iii) predictive coupling that "projection magnitude correlates with behavioral trait strength" and that the matching teacher trait direction yields the largest projection, thereby fixing trait identity and expected expression from an independently measurable weight-space quantity. This establishes both a phenomenon—traits can be decoded from student weight deltas—and a partial mechanism—subliminal transmission is an "approximately linear displacement toward the teacher's trait geometry"—although it does not fully explain how the training examples induce that displacement; this matters because Cloud et al. (2025) make shared-initialization parameter movement central to their account, while task-vector work such as Ilharco et al. (2023) treats weight deltas as behavior-bearing objects. True and false are distinguishable: failure would reject this teacher-derived linear readout and coupling, but, as the claim concedes, would not rule out nonlinear or basis-dependent parameter transmission, so the negative branch is informative but bounded. After substituting away the specific projection law, the topic alone would not merit this score; the matched-direction ordering and quantitative behavior coupling are more constraining than the median proposal to merely locate a subliminal-learning representation.

reach.justification: The named handle is "projecting the flattened weight delta onto a teacher-derived 'trait direction'," yielding both a top-1 trait diagnostic and a projection magnitude; it is ex ante with respect to behavioral elicitation because the claim says the trait can be read "without ever running the student." After directions are re-extracted for a new shared base, the substantive prediction survives as a relation—the matching direction should rank highest and its magnitude should track trait strength—rather than merely supplying an open-ended search procedure, although the claim predicts collapse when shared initialization is broken. Its asserted scope is therefore shared-initialization subliminal learning with known candidate trait directions, and the downstream users could include weight-access auditors who screen a finetuned model before deployment, but not API-only auditors or arbitrary cross-family settings. The topic-substitution check lowers no further: subliminal learning alone supplies no weight-only audit handle, whereas this particular conclusion supplies one with lead time and a transferable within-setting predictive relation.
